snippet.title: Kinetic Neo Ornate Bout - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo on steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298240/Kinetic_Neo_Ornate_Bout/?utm_source=yt&utm_medium=demo_trailer&utm_campaign=nextfest

Play two games at the same time—each with one stick of your controller. 
Score points, gain abilities, and don't forget to push the snails towards your opponent! 
They are the third and final dread in this extra hard multitasking challenge. 
K.N.O.B. will melt your brain! Play local with friends.

Coming Q4 2025
